database_note: Transaction tables are payment, rental, and inventory, recording financial activity, film loans, and physical stock. Lookup tables include actor, address, category, city, country, customer, film, language, staff, and store, describing entities and their attributes. The film_actor and film_category tables act as junctions linking films to actors and categories. Connections flow as follows: customer links to address and store; staff links to address and store; store links to address and staff. City links to country. Film links to language. Inventory links to film and store. Rental links to customer, inventory, and staff. Payment links to customer, staff, and rental. These relationships allow you to trace a payment back through the rental to the specific film copy, customer, and staff member involved.
database_fact: Transaction tables are payment, rental, and inventory, recording financial activity, film loans, and physical stock. Lookup tables include actor, address, category, city, country, customer, film, language, staff, and store, describing entities and their attributes. The film_actor and film_category tables act as junctions linking films to actors and categories. Connections flow as follows: customer links to address and store; staff links to address and store; store links to address and staff. City links to country. Film links to language. Inventory links to film and store. Rental links to customer, inventory, and staff. Payment links to customer, staff, and rental.
